units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 3) in the case specified in paragraph 3(3) of this Article, the maximum percentage of the minimum monetary savings in the contracting authority's relevant energy supply expenditure payable to the service provider under the contract.
units.label: Point 3 Part 16 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 17. The service provider's obligation is to achieve the contractual savings in physical units in the contracting authority's relevant energy resource supply expenditure, without regard to savings in monetary terms. The performance requirements established under paragraph 19 of this Article shall be taken into account.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 18. Payment under an energy service contract shall be based on the contractual savings in physical units in the contracting authority's relevant energy supply expenditure and the percentage of those savings, valued at the actual prices or tariffs for the relevant energy resources during the performance period.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 19. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish requirements for energy service contract terms, including performance and payment terms as regards determination of actual energy prices or tariffs for payment, and special rules for determining the initial (maximum) contract or lot price, including the period over which the contracting authority's energy resource supply expenditure is taken into account.
units.label: Part 19 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 110. Special rules for concluding state contracts for procurement of goods, works and services included in the state defence order and for procurement of material assets supplied to the state material reserve
units.text: Article 110. Special rules for concluding state contracts for procurement of goods, works and services included in the state defence order and for procurement of material assets supplied to the state material reserve
units.label: Art. 110

units.locator: Article 110. Special rules for concluding state contracts for procurement of goods, works and services included in the state defence order and for procurement of material assets supplied to the state material reserve
units.text: 1. The Government of the Russian Federation may approve a list of goods, work and services included in the State defence order for which suppliers (contractors, service providers), regardless of legal form or ownership, may not refuse to conclude a contract. The price of such a contract shall be determined under Article 22 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 110

units.locator: Article 110. Special rules for concluding state contracts for procurement of goods, works and services included in the state defence order and for procurement of material assets supplied to the state material reserve
units.text: 2. Suppliers holding a dominant position in a commodity market, and organisations whose State defence order accounts for more than seventy percent of production, may not refuse to conclude a State contract to supply material assets to the State material reserve.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 110

units.locator: Article 110.1. Special rules for concluding a contract for the creation of a work of architecture, urban planning or landscape architecture and/or the development, on that basis, of design documentation for capital construction projects
units.text: Article 110.1. Special rules for concluding a contract for the creation of a work of architecture, urban planning or landscape architecture and/or the development, on that basis, of design documentation for capital construction projects
units.label: Art. 110.1

units.locator: Article 110.1. Special rules for concluding a contract for the creation of a work of architecture, urban planning or landscape architecture and/or the development, on that basis, of design documentation for capital construction projects
units.text: 1. A contract for creation of a work of architecture, urban planning or landscape art and/or preparation on its basis of design documentation for capital construction facilities shall provide that:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 110.1

units.locator: Article 110.1. Special rules for concluding a contract for the creation of a work of architecture, urban planning or landscape architecture and/or the development, on that basis, of design documentation for capital construction projects
units.text: 1) the Russian Federation, constituent entity of the Russian Federation or municipality on whose behalf the contract is concluded shall hold the exclusive right to use the work created under it by preparing design documentation for a capital construction facility on its basis and by realising the work of architecture, urban planning or landscape art;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 110.1

units.locator: Article 110.1. Special rules for concluding a contract for the creation of a work of architecture, urban planning or landscape architecture and/or the development, on that basis, of design documentation for capital construction projects
units.text: 2) the contracting authority may repeatedly use the design documentation prepared on the basis of the work of architecture, urban planning or landscape art without the author's consent.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 110.1

units.locator: Article 110.1. Special rules for concluding a contract for the creation of a work of architecture, urban planning or landscape architecture and/or the development, on that basis, of design documentation for capital construction projects
units.text: 2. The author of the work of architecture, urban planning or landscape art may not require the contracting authority procuring the design documentation specified in paragraph 1(2) of this Article to grant the author the right to conclude a contract for its preparation without competitive methods.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 110.1

units.locator: Article 110.2. Special rules for concluding and performing a contract for the preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys, and contracts for the construction or reconstruction of capital construction projects
units.text: Article 110.2. Special rules for concluding and performing a contract for the preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys, and contracts for the construction or reconstruction of capital construction projects
units.label: Art. 110.2

units.locator: Article 110.2. Special rules for concluding and performing a contract for the preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys, and contracts for the construction or reconstruction of capital construction projects
units.text: 1. A contract for preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys shall provide that, from acceptance of the work results, exclusive rights to those results belong to the Russian Federation, constituent entity or municipality on whose behalf the State or municipal contracting authority acts.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 110.2

units.locator: Article 110.2. Special rules for concluding and performing a contract for the preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys, and contracts for the construction or reconstruction of capital construction projects
units.text: 2. The Government of the Russian Federation may specify the types and volume of construction or reconstruction work on capital construction facilities that the contractor must perform itself without involving other persons, except its subsidiaries, in performance of contractual obligations.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 110.2

units.locator: Article 110.2. Special rules for concluding and performing a contract for the preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys, and contracts for the construction or reconstruction of capital construction projects
units.text: 3. Under a contract for design documentation and/or engineering surveys in accordance with Russian Federation urban development legislation, the work result shall be the design documentation and/or a document containing the survey results. If the Urban Planning Code of the Russian Federation requires expert examination of the design documentation and/or survey results, those documents shall qualify as the completed design and/or survey work result only if there is a positive expert opinion on them.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 110.2

units.locator: Article 110.2. Special rules for concluding and performing a contract for the preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys, and contracts for the construction or reconstruction of capital construction projects
units.text: 4. The result of work under a contract for construction or reconstruction of a capital construction facility shall be the constructed and/or reconstructed facility for which the State construction supervision body has issued an opinion confirming conformity with design documentation and, in the cases under Article 54(5) of the Urban Planning Code of the Russian Federation, a federal State environmental supervision opinion has been obtained.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 110.2

units.locator: Article 110.2. Special rules for concluding and performing a contract for the preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys, and contracts for the construction or reconstruction of capital construction projects
units.text: 5. A contract for construction and/or reconstruction of capital construction facilities shall provide for staged payment for the contractor's work based on its volume and the contract price.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 110.2

units.locator: Article 110.2. Special rules for concluding and performing a contract for the preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys, and contracts for the construction or reconstruction of capital construction projects
units.text: 6. The volume and content of construction or reconstruction work shall be determined by the facility's design documentation and other technical documentation provided for in the contract. The work shall follow the construction and installation schedule, which is a mandatory contract attachment.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 110.2

units.locator: Article 110.2. Special rules for concluding and performing a contract for the preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys, and contracts for the construction or reconstruction of capital construction projects
units.text: 6.1. Payment for work shall be within the construction or reconstruction contract price, in accordance with its estimate, within the periods and amounts set by the contract or any work-payment schedule, taking account of the construction and installation schedule and work actually completed. The contract estimate shall be prepared within the contract price without using the estimate norms included in the federal register or estimated construction resource prices provided for in the design documentation under the Urban Planning Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6.1 Art. 110.2

units.locator: Article 110.2. Special rules for concluding and performing a contract for the preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys, and contracts for the construction or reconstruction of capital construction projects
units.text: 7. Methodologies for preparing the contract estimate, work-payment schedule and construction and installation schedule shall be approved by the federal executive authority authorised by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 110.2

units.locator: Article 110.2. Special rules for concluding and performing a contract for the preparation of design documentation and/or engineering surveys, and contracts for the construction or reconstruction of capital construction projects
units.text: 8. Within ten working days after acceptance of the facility and submission by the contractor of the documents it holds that are required under the Urban Planning Code of the Russian Federation to obtain the State construction supervision conformity opinion and, in the cases under Article 54(5) of that Code, the federal State environmental supervision opinion, the contracting authority shall send them to the bodies authorised to issue those opinions. Within ten working days after receiving the relevant opinion or opinions and the contractor's available documents required under the Urban Planning Code for a permit to put the facility into operation, the contracting authority shall send the documents to the bodies authorised under that Code to issue the permit.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 110.2

units.locator: Article 111. Special rules for procurement pursuant to a decision of the Government of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 111. Special rules for procurement pursuant to a decision of the Government of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 111

units.locator: Article 111. Special rules for procurement pursuant to a decision of the Government of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. The Government of the Russian Federation may set special arrangements for a particular procurement, including a supplier (contractor, service provider) selection method not provided for in Article 24 of this Federal Law. To create additional technological and economic advantages for the Russian Federation, including reciprocal obligations, it may also set additional performance terms unrelated to the contract's subject matter.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 111

units.locator: Article 111. Special rules for procurement pursuant to a decision of the Government of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The procurement procedure established by this Federal Law shall apply to procurement for which the Government of the Russian Federation has set special arrangements and/or additional performance terms under paragraph 1 of this Article, taking account of those arrangements and/or terms.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 111

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.label: Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: 1. Contracting authorities operating in a foreign State shall conduct procurement there under this Federal Law's procedures for closed tenders and closed auctions, subject to the following:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: 1) information and documents required by this Federal Law shall not be posted in the unified information system;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: 2) approvals under Article 72(2) and Article 93(5)(4) of this Federal Law and oversight under Article 99(5) and (5.1) of this Federal Law shall not be carried out;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: 3) an invitation shall be sent to at least three participants. It shall contain the information in Article 73(2) of this Federal Law, information that applications may be submitted using any means of communication and delivery, including in writing in a sealed envelope preventing inspection before the application deadline, and information on application of the special rules in this paragraph;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: 4) an application may not be rejected for failure to comply with Article 43(7) of this Federal Law or failure to submit the declaration under Article 43(1)(1)(о) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: 5) a contract following a closed tender or closed auction shall be concluded no later than twenty days starting on the day after the final supplier (contractor, service provider) selection record is signed, in the written form required by the law of the foreign State where procurement takes place, or, if no such law exists, in accordance with that country's business customs;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: 6) the contracting authority may:
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: а) refrain from applying Articles 14, 23, 28–30, 34–37, 41, 44, 45, 103 and 104 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 6 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: б) require participants to satisfy requirements set under Russian Federation legislation and/or the law of the foreign State where procurement takes place for persons supplying the goods, performing the work or providing the services procured;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 6 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: в) include terms in the draft contract taking account of the law of the foreign State where procurement takes place;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 6 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: г) require performance security in cases specified in this Federal Law or the law of the foreign State where procurement takes place, or refrain from requiring it in cases specified in that foreign law;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 6 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: д) refrain from preparing and approving procurement documentation. In that case, the invitation shall include the information and documents under Article 72(1)(1), subpoints а–д, of this Federal Law, taking account of the special rules in this paragraph;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 6 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: е) omit the procedure for submitting offers of the contract price or total of unit prices of goods, work and services, in the case under Article 22(24) of this Federal Law, during a closed auction;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 6 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: 7) if the contracting authority omits the price-offer procedure under point 6, subpoint е, of this paragraph, including offers of the total of unit prices in the case under Article 22(24) of this Federal Law:
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: а) the application shall contain the information in Article 43(1), point 3 or 4, of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 7 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: б) no application examination record shall be prepared, and the actions under Article 74(2)(2) of this Federal Law shall not be taken;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 7 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: в) no later than the date for finalising supplier (contractor, service provider) selection stated in the invitation, the actions under Article 74(2)(1) and (5) of this Federal Law shall be taken;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 7 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: г) the final selection record shall contain the information in Article 74, paragraph 3, points 1 and 2, and paragraph 6, points 3–6, of this Federal Law.
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 7 Part 1 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: 2. The Government of the Russian Federation may determine:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: 1) special procurement planning rules for contracting authorities operating in a foreign State;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: 2) specific contracting authorities operating abroad for which particular procurement planning and implementation rules may be established.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.1. Special rules for planning and conducting procurement in a foreign state to support the activities of contracting authorities operating in a foreign state
units.text: 3. Repealed from 1 January 2022. — Federal Law of 02.07.2021 No. 360-FZ.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 111.1

units.locator: Article 111.2. Special rules for performing a contract for the provision of a loan
units.text: Article 111.2. Special rules for performing a contract for the provision of a loan
units.label: Art. 111.2

units.locator: Article 111.2. Special rules for performing a contract for the provision of a loan
units.text: Unless the lending-service contract provides otherwise, the service provider may pledge its claim against the contracting authority under that contract to the Central Bank of the Russian Federation as security for its obligations under Central Bank loans; if that pledged claim is foreclosed in the established procedure, it may pass to the Central Bank of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Art. 111.2 · text

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.label: Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 1. If all the following conditions are met, the Government of the Russian Federation may, by an act adopted taking account of paragraph 2 of this Article, designate the investor party to a special investment contract, or another person engaged by it, establishing, modernising and/or mastering production of goods in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract concluded pursuant to Federal Law No. 488-FZ of 31 December 2014 On Industrial Policy in the Russian Federation (hereinafter for this Article the manufacturer), as sole supplier of those goods, information on which is entered in the register of sole suppliers of goods whose production is established, modernised or mastered, and sole providers of services using property (immovable property or technologically interconnected immovable and movable property) that is created or reconstructed:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 1) the special investment contract was concluded by the Russian Federation, or by it together with a constituent entity and/or municipality;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 2) investment under the special investment contract in establishing, modernising and/or mastering production in the Russian Federation exceeds three billion roubles, or seven hundred and fifty million roubles if the manufacturer is included in the consolidated register of defence-industrial complex organisations formed under Article 21(2) of Federal Law No. 488-FZ of 31 December 2014 On Industrial Policy in the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 3) the goods will be manufactured in the Russian Federation by a Russian legal entity;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 4) the Russian Federation is the country of origin of the goods whose production is established, modernised and/or mastered there under the special investment contract;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 5) the special investment contract contains suspensive conditions applicable if the Government act in this paragraph is adopted, providing for:
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: а) the manufacturer's right to conclude supply contracts under Article 93(1)(47) of this Federal Law. The total quantity of each named product supplied under that point during a calendar year shall not exceed thirty percent of its output of that product in that year. This restriction does not apply to a special investment contract with a manufacturer in the register specified in paragraph 1(2) of this Article;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 5 Part 1 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: б) the manufacturer's liability for exceeding the total quantity in subpoint а of this point, in the form of a fine equal to fifty percent of the value of the excess;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 5 Part 1 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: в) the manufacturer's obligation to prepare and post in the unified information system a report on compliance with subpoint а of this point, in the form, under the requirements and within the periods set by the Government of the Russian Federation under paragraph 3(5) of this Article.
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 5 Part 1 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 2. The Government act under paragraph 1 of this Article shall specify, among other things:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 111.3

units.locator: Article 111.3. Special rules for procurement of goods whose production is established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract
units.text: 1) the federal executive authority that concluded the special investment contract on behalf of the Russian Federation, or of it together with a constituent entity and/or municipality;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 111.3
